title: MCP server layer is implemented but undeclared as a dependency and untested
evidence: mcp_server.py:15-20,41,166-299,302-395,400-418 implements a real MCP server (Server SDK, @server.list_tools with 11 Tool definitions, @server.call_tool dispatcher, stdio_server main() entrypoint) — the prior 'broken registration/no entrypoint' failure is fixed. BUT requirements.txt (fastapi/uvicorn/pandas/python-dotenv/sse-starlette) omits 'mcp', so `import mcp_server` raises ModuleNotFoundError on a clean install per the declared deps; and no test imports mcp_server (test_soccer.py:14-15 imports only data_loader/query_engine), so all 11 tools, call_tool and main() are 0% covered (test_coverage=0.62).
suggestion: Add 'mcp' to requirements.txt and add at least one test that imports mcp_server, calls list_tools(), and dispatches call_tool() for a couple of tools.

title: test_get_player_by_name conditionally skips when FIFA data absent
evidence: test_soccer.py:123 pytest.skip('FIFA data not available') — guarded by `if data_loader.fifa_df is None`. fifa_data.csv is present so it runs here, but the guard can silently drop player coverage.
suggestion: Assert the FIFA data loads as a precondition rather than skipping player tests.
